addressBook.zh: 企业用户、部门、用户组与组织架构管理，含通讯录可见性、组织维度、合作伙伴、职务与域名、管理员权限及账号同步。
addressBook.en: Manage enterprise users, departments, user groups and org structure, including contact visibility, org dimensions, partner companies, titles and domains, admin permissions, and account sync.

calendars.zh: 日历、日程、重复日程实例、参与者、日程会议室、日程纪要、忙闲查询及 Exchange 日历绑定。
calendars.en: Calendars, events, recurring event instances, attendees, event meeting rooms, event minutes, free/busy lookup, and Exchange calendar bindings.

chats.zh: IM 群会话、单聊与消息管理，含群成员、消息发送/撤回/更新、书签、资源上传及会话数据同步。
chats.en: IM group chats, direct chats and messages, including members, send/recall/update messages, bookmarks, resource uploads, and chat data sync.

meetings.zh: 在线会议、参会人、录制、纪要、会议室及其等级/标签/预订/白名单/黑名单/设置与预约管理。
meetings.en: Online meetings, participants, recordings, minutes, meeting rooms with levels, tags, bookings, privileged/banned users and settings, plus room reservations.

mail.zh: 邮箱、公共邮箱、用户邮箱、邮件联系人、邮件组、邮件归档、邮件迁移与邮件搜索等邮件能力。
mail.en: Mailboxes, public and user mailboxes, mail contacts, mail groups, mail archiving, mail migration, and mail message search.

drive.zh: 云盘与文件管理：文件/文件夹增删改查、上传下载、权限、版本、分享链接、回收站、空间配额、文件标签及常用/最近/收藏等快捷文件。
drive.en: Drive and file management: file/folder CRUD, upload/download, permissions, versions, share links, recycle bin, quota, file labels, and frequent/recent/starred items.

documents.zh: 在线文档内容操作：评论、点赞、附件上传下载与文档导出。
documents.en: Online document content operations: comments, likes, attachments, and document export.

filetransfer.zh: 文件安全外发与传输：上传/下载、加密、预览、审批任务与外发任务管理。
filetransfer.en: Secure file transfer and outbound delivery: upload/download, encryption, preview, approval and transfer tasks.

wiki.zh: 知识库（Wiki）管理：空间、成员、文档增删改查、移动复制与搜索。
wiki.en: Wiki knowledge base: spaces, members, document CRUD, move/copy, and search.

doclib.zh: 文档库（DocLib）管理：文档库创建、设置、搜索、邀请链接与文件继承。
doclib.en: Document library (DocLib): create, settings, search, invite links, and file inheritance.

sheets.zh: 电子表格（表格/ET）管理：工作表、区域数据、数据校验、筛选、保护范围与区域权限。
sheets.en: Spreadsheet (ET) management: worksheets, range data, data validations, filters, protection ranges, and regional permissions.

dbsheet.zh: 多维表（DBase）管理：数据表、字段、记录、视图、表单、仪表盘、钩子与内容权限。
dbsheet.en: Multi-dimensional table (DBase) management: sheets, fields, records, views, forms, dashboards, hooks, and content permissions.

airsheet.zh: 智能表格（AirSheet）管理：工作表、区域数据、筛选、数据校验、保护范围与导入。
airsheet.en: Smart spreadsheet (AirSheet) management: worksheets, range data, filters, data validations, protection ranges, and imports.

airpage.zh: 智能文档（AirPage）管理：块（Block）操作、导入导出与文档转换。
airpage.en: Smart document (AirPage) management: block operations, import/export, and document conversion.

lowCodeApp.zh: 低代码应用实例管理：应用成员、数据表、字段与记录。
lowCodeApp.en: Low-code app instances: app members, tables, fields, and records.

ai.zh: AI 开放能力：AI 对话/问答、文档智能（AIDocs）、文档问答、AI 演示、语音转写、长任务及流式（SSE）推送。
ai.en: AI capabilities: AI chat/Q&A, document intelligence (AIDocs), document QA, AI slides, speech transcription, long-running tasks, and SSE streaming.

developer.zh: 开发者平台：应用管理、开发者中心、应用角标、工作台模块与收藏、控制台设置、OAuth 授权、服务主体、事件出口 IP、数据追踪与特权能力。
developer.en: Developer platform: app management, DevHub, app badges, workbench blocks/favorites, console settings, OAuth, service principals, event egress IPs, data tracking, and privilege capabilities.

store.zh: 应用商店与订阅：订单、许可分配与激活，以及订阅账号与发布内容管理。
store.en: App store and subscriptions: orders, entitlement allocations and activation, plus subscription accounts and published contents.

security.zh: 安全与合规：加密文档、机密文档、文件密级标签、水印溯源、内容安全扫描规则/任务与词库。
security.en: Security and compliance: encrypted/confidential documents, file classification labels, watermark traceability, content-scan rules/tasks, and word libraries.

audit.zh: 审计与合规：会话审计（群聊存档）、审计日志与审计分类。
audit.en: Auditing and compliance: chat auditing/archival, audit logs, and audit categories.

attendance.zh: 考勤管理：考勤组、打卡记录与审批记录。
attendance.en: Attendance management: attendance groups, punch records, and approval records.

announce.zh: 企业公告管理：公告查询、附件下载与可见范围。
announce.en: Company announcements: query, attachment download, and visibility scopes.

workflow.zh: 审批流与自动化：审批定义、审批实例与文件自动化流程。
workflow.en: Approval workflows and automation: approval definitions, approval instances, and file automation workflows.

todo.zh: 待办任务管理：个人任务、任务分类与任务状态。
todo.en: Todo and task management: personal tasks, task categories, and task statuses.
